body:
Worker trap (Termal::BarA1, 2026-10-23 07:37Z). A handoff offer's expires_at is capped at the holder's claim expiry, whatever ttl you pass. While items wait in Merger's queue, my claims on w-2f344 and w-7fcb lapsed (06:13Z, 06:33Z), and their offers silently died with them. A LIVE offer also blocks renewing the claim ("a live handoff offer blocks this operation").

Rule: when handing to Merger, claim with a long ttl first (e.g. 4h) and then offer. Track each offer's expiry. Before it lapses: cancel the offer, renew the claim, re-offer to session-11865, and mail Merger the new offer id. Inputs are unchanged by this.
